name: remotion-captions
summary: 使用这项 Remotion 技能，将字幕整理为可复用的字幕轨道，用于显示和制作动画。文档片段展示了如何从 @remotion/captions 导入 Caption 类型，并要求将字幕数据处理为符合该类型的 JSON。

Use this Remotion skill to prepare a reusable subtitle track for display and animation. The excerpt shows how to import the Caption type from @remotion/captions and specifies that caption data must be processed as JSON conforming to that type.
